definition: to require something you do not have
description: A messy hotel room the morning after a party, with sunlight coming through white curtains. A young woman with red hair, a gold sequin dress and smudged make-up lies on the carpet and stretches her arm out towards a glass of water on a low table, grabs it and rolls onto her side holding it. A paper party hat lies next to her. Confetti, playing cards, banknotes, silver trays and bottles cover the floor, and a man in a white shirt and tie sleeps on the sofa behind her.

de.answer: Sie greift nach einem Glas Wasser.
